inspection_method: view_image on original native frame0 and three rendered contact sheets; native panels retained beside clearly labelled added GT layers
original_native_samples: No tracking bounding boxes or track-ID labels observed in these five samples. Native source has a small blurred timestamp-like marking at the top left and blurred image regions outside the central pen; not described as entirely text-free or unprocessed raw sensor imagery.
direct_GT_coordinates_control: At original scale, all three sampled overlays are too small and displaced toward the upper-left relative to the visible cows.
author_motivated_GT_times_2_control: At video0 0, 8991 and 26973, scaled boxes are broadly consistent with the visible cows. Individual boundaries are approximate and no independent manual IoU was measured.
endpoint_sample: At video0 53919, GT1 53920 times 2 broadly corresponds to eight visible cows. This supports a prefix-alignment hypothesis, not proof of every intermediate frame or its exact offset.
last_source_frame: Video0 53945 is decodable and shows a very similar pen arrangement. Last-GT boxes were drawn ONLY as explicitly labelled context; no GT for this frame was fabricated.
scene_observation: Enclosed fisheye view of a small pen with feeding and resting areas, a concrete lane and gate-like passages. Complete farm entrance/exit events and stable bidirectional passage regions have not been certified from these still images.
caption_and_layer_distinction: Native and added GT layers are explicitly labelled, and missing tail GT is visible in the final contact sheet. Contact-sheet text is legible when opened at native output size.
original_summary_metadata_correction: In results/frame_review/summary.json, the field named ffprobe_stderr actually contains the ffmpeg extraction stderr. Raw extraction .log files were retained. Decoder source has been corrected to use separate ffprobe_stderr and ffmpeg_stderr for future runs; historical summary is preserved without rerunning or overwriting images. Warnings concern short raw H264 rate estimation and single-image naming; packet count, image decode and dimensions passed.
